questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I wanted to explore and try to live in a new culture and country, that the exchange were able to provide me with. Besides it was also because of the privilege to try to study at another university and see how it is done at different universities. Finally, I were able to take some other courses than on my home university, that I really find interesting.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I think that the level of the teaching and the quality of it was below what I am used to at the University of Copenhagen.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: I think it was hard to find the information at Bologna University and that it was a stressfull experience. Many of the things I needed to do at the start of the semester on Bologna University was very ineffective and needed to be at a specific time and physically. Besides I might think that the Mobility Online platform is a little bit confusing and outdated.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I didn't receive much, but I don't remember exactly what I received.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I think it was okay, but we were also 4 people who wanted to find an apartment together, and I might think that helped.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Be carefull not to be cheated. I know that some is.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I think it was okay, but I also think that our firm charged us some money, that I didn't understand. This you shall probably be ready for.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I was very confusing and done in a more difficult way than it needed to.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: We had to have a meeting with a guy, I actually don't really understand who he was, but he had to register us through an online meeting that only happened at some specific times of the week. Besides some things were done through there websites, which I also found confusing.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: We could write to them through mail.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: It was okay, but I actually wanted some other classes but weren't able to take them because they are master courses at Bologna University and Bologna University won't allow bachelor students to take master courses, but KU allows it.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be aware that you as a bachelor student can't take master cources at Bologna University.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It was a lower level than on Copenhagen University.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: We only have lectures not any group teaching.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Principles of Management
Monetary Economics
Applied Political Sociology
Industrial Organization

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would definitely recommend Applied Political Sociology. The teacher is very good and his interest and commitment to the course really shone through. I really think that this was an interesting course, and I would definitely recommend it!

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: We got a higher electricity bill at our apartment than expected, because the firm that we were rented the apartment of had very high electricity prices.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: The food, coffee and drinks were cheaper than expected, and the electricity prices at the apartment were more expensive than expected.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The sport activities at the university were very expensive and not that good.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: There were sport activities available, but as just said it was very expensive and not very good. I was free to go on many museums as a student.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Go to the football stadium and watch football games.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: As just wrote to go to the football stadium and watch football games. Or take visits to other nearby cities with the train.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: I think I was hard, because the students talked during the lectures, which I just find very regrettable.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Talk to students doing the lectures. There are many internaional! Or join the ESN Bologna events. You can find them on Instagram.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: That students talked through the lectures.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: I was a very laid back culture in many ways which I like.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Make sure to take the right cources - for example you can't take master cources as a bachelor student.
Make sure to check the mails and informations, so you follow the deadlines. You can always just write the universities if you are confused.
Make sure to find a good place to live in good time!

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Not anything I didn't wrote, that I can think of right now.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: I is a so nice and privileged to go to another city and just study and live there and take your SU with you and get the erasmus grant or other grants you can try to seek.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: I was the teaching which I didn't think was very good.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
